t: This is Edgware Road, a major road that starts at Marble Arch and runs north to Edgware. It began as part of the Roman Watling Street, and unusually for London it runs for ten miles in an almost perfectly straight line. Along the way it changes names several times, but it is all one road. Two people died on it. Thomas Jones was a Welsh mathematician and head tutor at Trinity College, Cambridge, who mentored Adam Sedgwick. John Breynton was a minister in Halifax, Nova Scotia.
